reckless-charge.name: Reckless Charge
reckless-charge.text: Choose one — move one of your units one zone, even if exhausted (this doesn't exhaust it); OR target unit gets +1 Power this round for each other red unit in its zone (either side's).
reckless-charge.designerNote:
Session 006: was "gains Rush" permanently — dead text under decision 41 (Rush only matters the round a unit enters play, so a permanent grant on a veteran does nothing, ever). Now scoped to the round: the real play is on a unit you just dropped — its first move becomes free, so it can cross a zone and still fight.

2026-07-11 (designer, PR #13 + #14): cost 1 → 0 and became modal — the second mode is the pack-fury
pump counting ALL red units in the zone, enemy red included (rage recognizes rage). First modal card
in the game; the mode is declared when you cast.

2026-07-12 (designer, issue #26 → decision 72): the round-scoped Rush grant was STILL dead on any
unit from an earlier round (the free move only exists the round a unit entered) and useless on an
exhausted unit (it can't move at all). Mode rebuilt in the designer's own words: an immediate
one-zone lunge, exhausted or not, exhausting nothing. New vocabulary: op `move` + zone target
`adjacentToFirst`. A genuinely *reckless* charge — hurl a spent soldier forward.

cinder-initiate.name: Cinder Initiate
cinder-initiate.designerNote:
Decision 35: when attacking you MAY overextend for +N power; the unit takes N damage at end of round. A gamble, not a given.

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 1): Overextend is cut (#9); the gamble is priced in — 1/1 becomes 2/1. Red's opening jab.

devastating-strike.name: Devastating Strike
devastating-strike.text: Deal 2 damage to target unit — 3 instead if it's already damaged.
devastating-strike.designerNote:
Session 006: became unit-only. Red's burn grammar — unit-only burn deals cost+1, face-capable burn deals exactly cost (the reach is the tax). This is the efficient unit-killer; Searing Bolt is the flexible one.

2026-07-11 (designer, issue #4): finish-the-wounded clause added (2, or 3 to a damaged unit) —
first conditional-bonus card. Pairs with red's chip damage; the executioner rewards setup.

spark-hound.name: Spark Hound
spark-hound.text: Rush. When this attacks, it gets +1 Power this round.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.designerNote: 2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 1): Overextend is cut (#9); THE Scar bearer — the wound-powered berserker is the keyword's face (decision 70 cap applies).

blood-rush.name: Blood Rush
blood-rush.text: Remove all damage from a unit you control; deal that much damage to your Home.
blood-rush.designerNote:
2026-07-11 (designer, issue #4): full rework — the wound comes home. Red's healing is a
mortgage: your champion fights on, your Home bleeds for it. First linked-amount card.

pillage.name: Pillage
pillage.designerNote: Session 006: 4 mana → 2. Utility removal was priced like a threat; yellow runs seven upgrades and red needs a real answer at a price it can pay mid-assault.

searing-bolt.name: Searing Bolt

smash-through.name: Smash Through
smash-through.text: Target unit with Rush gains Breakthrough this round.

warpath.name: Warpath
warpath.text: Your units get +1 Power this round.
warpath.designerNote: Session 006 redesign: was "all friendly units gain Rush" permanently — dead text under decision 41 (see Reckless Charge). Rebuilt as the go-wide pump: 2 mana, +1 Power to the whole board for the round. Last Stand (+2 and a blood price) is its big sibling.

bloodfrenzy.name: Bloodfrenzy
bloodfrenzy.text: Attached unit gets +1 Power and Armor 1. At the start of your round, if you have 10 or less life, attached unit gets +1 Power permanently.
bloodfrenzy.designerNote:
Session 006: threshold 5 → 10 life and cost 5 → 3. At ≤5 life the game is usually already decided; half-life is where red's desperation engine should start paying.

2026-07-11 (designer, issue #4): immediate +1 Power / Armor 1 on attach added; the ≤10-life
desperation engine unchanged. Threshold kept at "10 or less" (established) though the request
said "less than 10" — flagged on the thread.

collateral-damage.name: Collateral Damage
collateral-damage.text: Deal 2 damage to two different target units.

fiery-impaler.name: Fiery Impaler
fiery-impaler.text: When this attacks a unit, it also deals 1 damage to the strongest other enemy unit in that zone.
fiery-impaler.designerNote: Session 006: text now states the deterministic pick (decision 51) instead of the vague "an adjacent unit".

rageforged-brute.name: Rageforged Brute
rageforged-brute.designerNote: 2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 1): Overextend is cut (#9); stat comp instead of a second keyword — 4/3 becomes 4/4.

volcanic-slam.name: Volcanic Slam
volcanic-slam.text: Deal 3 damage to up to two units in the same zone.
volcanic-slam.designerNote:
2026-07-11 (designer, issue #4): one eruption, one zone — trades face-reach for a second body.
First upTo/sameZone card. Under decision 68's curve a 3-cost dealing up to 6 across two bodies
is the convex rate red wants.

blaze-juggernaut.name: Blaze Juggernaut
blaze-juggernaut.designerNote:
Reach (canon since v2.0 audit): may attack into an adjacent zone like Ranged, but unlike Ranged it can assault bases and does take counter-damage.

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 4): Reach is cut (#8, designer-confirmed). The juggernaut stops poking over walls and starts going through them: Rush + Breakthrough 2.

burning-oath.name: Burning Oath
burning-oath.text: Attached unit gets +2 Power and Breakthrough.
burning-oath.designerNote: Session 006 redesign: was +2 Power and Rush — the Rush half was dead text on any unit already in play (decision 41). Breakthrough keeps the oath aggressive and permanent.

cataclysmic-charge.name: Cataclysmic Charge
cataclysmic-charge.text: Target unit gets +3 Power and Breakthrough this round.
cataclysmic-charge.designerNote: Session 006 redesign: was 6 mana for +3 Power and Rush this round — overcosted (Blood Rush gives +2 and Rush for 2) and the Rush rider was near-dead text on veterans. Now the single-target alpha strike: the Breakthrough rider makes the pump land on the base, not just the wall.

doombringer.name: Doombringer
doombringer.designerNote: Session 006 balance pass: 5 → 4 mana (sim-guided red curve compression; a hot statline for the cost — watch it in play).

execution-swing.name: Execution Swing
execution-swing.designerNote: Session 006: 6 mana → 4. Legal under the red charter as the "finish the fight" execute — it requires combat to have happened first (damaged-only); red still never gets unconditional destroy.

inferno-titan.name: Inferno Titan
inferno-titan.designerNote:
Session 006: 6/5 → 5/4. It beat the statline grammar by +3 while carrying two keywords — the pool's most undercosted body.

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 1): Overextend is cut (#9); Scar replaces the gamble: a 5/4 that grows angrier as it burns (max +2 at 2 damage).

rupture.name: Rupture
rupture.text: Deal 4 damage to target unit or base.

crimson-behemoth.name: Crimson Behemoth
crimson-behemoth.text: When this attacks a base, it deals 2 damage to every other unit in that zone — yours included.
crimson-behemoth.designerNote: Re-ruled after playtest 004: the assault splashes the defended Home zone, both sides (the original "adjacent zones" reading only ever hit Neutral — dead text during a siege). Session 006: 6/6 → 6/5 to sit on the statline grammar, and the text now says what actually happens.

relentless-assault.name: Relentless Assault
relentless-assault.designerNote: Session 006: retexted from "take an extra combat phase" (a phase that no longer exists — decision 40 dissolved the phase ladder). The effect was already ready-all; now the card says so.

warlord-garok.name: Warlord Garok
warlord-garok.text: Rush. Your other units have +1 Power.
warlord-garok.designerNote: Session 006 balance pass: 6 → 5 mana (sim-guided red curve compression).

burn-the-frontline.name: Burn the Frontline
burn-the-frontline.text: Choose a zone. Deal 6 damage to every unit there — yours included.
burn-the-frontline.designerNote: Session 006: was 7 mana for 4 damage in one zone — strictly worse than Scorching Howl (5 mana, 3 damage everywhere). Now the wall-breaker: 6 mana, 6 damage to one zone, both sides. Kills almost every yellow wall through the fortress plan; the friendly-fire is the red cost made visible.

earthshaker.name: Earthshaker
earthshaker.designerNote: 2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 1): Overextend is cut (#9); decision-68 curve: a 6-cost should do a lot — 6/5 becomes 7/5, plus Scar.

raging-inferno.name: Raging Inferno
raging-inferno.text: Deal 6 damage to target unit or base.
raging-inferno.designerNote: Session 006: 5 damage → 6, matching the face-capable burn grammar (damage = cost): Searing Bolt 2@2, Volcanic Slam 3@3, Rupture 4@4, Raging Inferno 6@6.

apocalypse-engine.name: Apocalypse Engine
apocalypse-engine.designerNote: 2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 1): Overextend is cut (#9); stays the pure breakthrough bomb; 7/7 becomes 8/7 (decision-68 curve).

last-stand.name: Last Stand
last-stand.text: Your units gain +2 Power this round. You lose 2 life.

unchained-rage.name: Unchained Rage
unchained-rage.text: Double the Power of all your units for the next 2 rounds.
unchained-rage.designerNote:
2026-07-11 (designer, issue #4): from one unit, one round — to YOUR WHOLE ARMY, TWO ROUNDS.
The poster child of decision 68 (superlinear curves): this is what a 7-cost feels like.
First multi-round, board-wide effect.

final-onslaught.name: Final Onslaught
final-onslaught.text: Ready one of your units, then immediately take an extra action.
final-onslaught.designerNote: Decision 43: rounds have no extra turns — "extra turn" became ready one of your units + an extra action. Unplayable with no friendly unit to ready, by design.

worldrender.name: Worldrender
worldrender.designerNote: 2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 1): Overextend is cut (#9); the apex predator: 9/8, Breakthrough, Scar — a wounded god hits harder (to a survivor's limit).

iron-discipline.name: Iron Discipline
iron-discipline.text: Attach to unit. This unit gets Armor 1. Gain 1 Influence.
iron-discipline.designerNote: Session 006: 2 → 1 mana. As an upgrade it can be Pillaged and feeds the upgrade-pressure rule — it should undercut the action version (Radiant Aegis).

oath-of-order.name: Oath of Order
oath-of-order.text: Attach to unit. This unit gets +1 Power and Guard.

prison-warrant.name: Prison Warrant
prison-warrant.text: Target unit you control captures target enemy unit with 2 or less Power. Gain 1 Influence.
prison-warrant.designerNote:
Session 006, the prison ladder (each imprison action now has one job): Warrant 1 = small fry. The old "in this zone" was meaningless from hand (decision 52 context) and an unrestricted 1-mana imprison embarrassed Detain at 6.

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. Rung 1: the small warrant — a warden order (first by-capture card). The captive is held until your warden readies or falls.

vanguard-sentinel.name: Vanguard Sentinel
vanguard-sentinel.text: Guard. When this defends, gain 1 Influence.
vanguard-sentinel.designerNote: Decision 34: influence is earned by events, never by existing — this unit pays out when it defends (is attacked).

binding-light.name: Binding Light
binding-light.text: Exhaust target enemy unit with 4 or less Power.
binding-light.designerNote:
Session 006, prison ladder: Binding Light 2 = midweight lockup, pure tempo (no influence rider). The old 10+ rider was dead text — prisoners already can't attack anything (decision 50 spirit).

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. Rung 2: the verdict of stillness — exhaustion is the new soft lock (blocking costs ready units in v3, so this bites twice).

containment-priest.name: Containment Priest
containment-priest.text: When this enters play, it captures target enemy unit with 2 or less Power.
containment-priest.designerNote:
Decision 51: the pick is deterministic (strongest eligible; ties go to the earliest arrival) and the text says so. Fires on deploy and on every move.

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. The priest carries its own cell now — a targeted capture on entry (was auto-imprison).

disciplined-mind.name: Disciplined Mind
disciplined-mind.text: Attach to unit. This unit gets Armor 1. Draw a card.

hold-the-line.name: Hold the Line
hold-the-line.text: Choose a zone. Your units there gain Guard. Gain 1 Influence.
hold-the-line.designerNote: Decision 52: "this zone" on an action means "choose a zone" — the text now says so.

radiant-aegis.name: Radiant Aegis
radiant-aegis.text: Target unit gets Armor 2, permanently. Gain 1 Influence.
radiant-aegis.designerNote: Session 006: 1 → 2 mana. Armor 2 blanks red's whole cheap-burn suite; at 1 mana it was the best card in the pool. The armor ladder: Aegis 2 (Armor 2, one unit), Radiant Wall 5 (Armor 3), Command Edict 7 (Armor 1, everyone).

sunguard-defender.name: Sunguard Defender
sunguard-defender.text: Guard. When this defends, gain 1 Influence.
sunguard-defender.designerNote: Decision 34: influence is earned by events, never by existing — this unit pays out when it defends (is attacked).

aura-of-resolve.name: Aura of Resolve
aura-of-resolve.text: Attach to unit. When this unit defends, gain 2 Influence.
aura-of-resolve.designerNote: Session 006 redesign: was "at the start of your round, gain 1 Influence" — passive income, illegal under the yellow charter (influence is event-earned, decision 34). Now it pays when the wearer defends: put it on a Guard and get paid for every intercept.

bulwark-protector.name: Bulwark Protector
bulwark-protector.text: Guard. When this defends, gain 1 Influence.
bulwark-protector.designerNote: Decision 34: influence is earned by events, never by existing — this unit pays out when it defends (is attacked).

chain-of-law.name: Chain of Law
chain-of-law.text: Attached unit has Guard and Armor 1. Gain 1 Influence.
chain-of-law.designerNote: 2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. Untargetable is purple's (as Hidden) now; the chain deputizes instead — Guard + Armor 1, and in v3 orphaned chains are salvageable (decision 67).

justicar-enforcer.name: Justicar Enforcer
justicar-enforcer.text: Guard. When this defends, gain 2 Influence.
justicar-enforcer.designerNote: Session 006 balance pass: payout restored to 2 — this is yellow's dedicated influence-engine guard (the vanilla walls pay 1). Sims: without real influence payouts yellow's second win axis never fires.

noble-purifier.name: Noble Purifier
noble-purifier.text: When this kills a unit, gain 2 Influence.
noble-purifier.designerNote:
Decision 51 text (deterministic pick — it may be the attack target itself, which cancels the counter-punch).

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. Purification through victory — righteous kills win the crowd (was auto-imprison on attack).

sanctified-bastion.name: Sanctified Bastion
sanctified-bastion.text: This can't attack. Other friendly units in this zone have Armor 1.
sanctified-bastion.designerNote: Session 006: the aura is now zone-local (was board-wide — a 3-mana wall quietly armoring the whole army from home). Walls protect what stands behind them.

subjugate.name: Subjugate
subjugate.text: Target enemy unit gets −2 Power permanently. Gain 1 Influence.
subjugate.designerNote:
Session 006, prison ladder: Subjugate 3 = unrestricted imprison that leaves a mark — the prisoner comes back weaker. The old "if your Influence is 5 or less" condition was noise; the rider is now unconditional.

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. Rung 3: the breaking — permanent humiliation instead of walls.

unwavering-faith.name: Unwavering Faith
unwavering-faith.text: Heal 3 damage from target unit. Gain 1 Influence.
unwavering-faith.designerNote: Session 006: became unit-only. The old targeting technically allowed healing the enemy base — the engine can't say "any unit or YOUR base" in one target, and the flexible version was dishonest text.

absolution.name: Absolution
absolution.text: Remove all negative effects from target unit you control. Free all your captured units. Gain 1 Influence.
absolution.designerNote:
Session 006: 7 → 3 mana and the text now says what removeNegative actually does (it is primarily a jailbreak). A situational cleanse was priced like a bomb.

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. The jailbreak: the first freeCaptives card — your people come home (dazed).

devout-intervention.name: Devout Intervention
devout-intervention.text: Prevent the next 3 damage to your base this round. Gain 1 Influence.
devout-intervention.designerNote: Session 006: 6 → 3 mana. A one-round shield priced like a wall.

disarming-order.name: Disarming Order
disarming-order.text: Target unit can't attack this round. Draw a card.
disarming-order.designerNote: Session 006: 5 → 3 mana. A one-round pacify plus a card is a trick, not a threat.

exemplar-knight.name: Exemplar Knight
exemplar-knight.text: When this attacks, it gets +2 Power this round. When it defeats a unit, gain 1 Influence.
exemplar-knight.designerNote: Decision 34: influence pays on the kill, not for existing. (Session 006: fixed a copy-paste note that claimed this was an on-defend card.)

fortress-keeper.name: Fortress Keeper
fortress-keeper.text: This can't attack. Other friendly units in this zone have Guard.

high-justiciar.name: High Justiciar
high-justiciar.text: Guard. When this defends, gain 2 Influence.
high-justiciar.designerNote:
Decision 51 text (deterministic pick, stated on the card).

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. Guard is free blocking in v3 — the Justiciar holds the line and the court pays it.

lawbringer.name: Lawbringer
lawbringer.text: Whenever this enters a zone, exhaust target enemy unit.
lawbringer.designerNote:
Decision 51 text. Containment Priest's big sibling: full statline plus the same arrest, two mana later.

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. The law arrives and the room goes quiet — repeatable discipline on every march.

light-of-authority.name: Light of Authority
light-of-authority.text: Target unit gets +3 Power this round. Gain 1 Influence.
light-of-authority.designerNote: Session 006: 6 → 3 mana (red's Cataclysmic Charge gives +3 AND Breakthrough 3 at 4 — yellow's pump can cost less because it converts defense, not kills).

resolve-banner.name: Resolve Banner
resolve-banner.text: Attach to unit. Other friendly units in this zone get +1 Power.
resolve-banner.designerNote: Session 006: 6 → 4 mana (red gets the same aura board-wide ON a 5/5 body for 6 — Warlord Garok).

sentence.name: Sentence
sentence.text: Target unit you control captures target enemy unit. Draw a card.
sentence.designerNote:
Session 006, prison ladder: Sentence 4 = imprison that replaces itself. The old 10+ rider duplicated what imprisonment already does.

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. Rung 4: the full sentence — any prisoner, plus the paperwork (draw).

censer-of-purity.name: Censer of Purity
censer-of-purity.text: At the start of your round, lose 1 Influence and heal 2 damage from your base.
censer-of-purity.designerNote: Charter-legal: this is influence *spent*, not earned — trading the track for life. Session 006: text made unconditional to match the effects (the old "if you do" implied a choice that never existed).

custodian-of-law.name: Custodian of Law
custodian-of-law.text: Guard. When this defends, gain 2 Influence.
custodian-of-law.designerNote: Decision 34: influence is earned by events, never by existing — this unit pays out when it defends (is attacked).

dawnspear-paladin.name: Dawnspear Paladin
dawnspear-paladin.designerNote: Session 006: dropped the "may" — strictly-beneficial effects auto-apply (decision 24), so the card now says what happens.

imprisonment-chamber.name: Imprisonment Chamber
imprisonment-chamber.text: Target unit you control captures target enemy unit. Gain 2 Influence.
imprisonment-chamber.designerNote:
Session 006, prison ladder: Chamber 5 = the political win — imprison plus the pool's biggest single influence payout. The old text restated the global decay rule (§1.11) as if it were a card effect; the ledger stopped lying.

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. Rung 5: the chamber — capture as civic spectacle.

radiant-judgment.name: Radiant Judgment
radiant-judgment.text: Exhaust every enemy unit with 3 or less Power. Gain 2 Influence.
radiant-judgment.designerNote: 2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. Mass judgment: the small are stilled everywhere.

radiant-wall.name: Radiant Wall
radiant-wall.text: Target unit gets Armor 3, permanently. Gain 1 Influence.
radiant-wall.designerNote: Session 006: 4 → 5 mana (armor ladder — see Radiant Aegis).

sanctify.name: Sanctify
sanctify.text: Heal 4 damage from your base. Gain 1 Influence.
sanctify.designerNote: Session 006: 6 → 4 mana, influence 2 → 1 (life-gain shouldn't also be the biggest influence payout — that belongs to the prison ladder's Chamber).

unshakable-wall.name: Unshakable Wall
unshakable-wall.text: Attach to unit. This unit gets +2 Armor and Guard.

detain.name: Detain
detain.text: Target unit you control captures target enemy unit. Your Home heals 3. Gain 1 Influence.
detain.designerNote:
Session 006, prison ladder: Detain 6 = the stabilizer — lock the threat away and bind the wound it left. Was a plain imprison+1 at 6 mana, strictly worse than the cheaper rungs.

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. Rung 6: order restored — the arrest, the healing, the standing.

gateward-colossus.name: Gateward Colossus
gateward-colossus.text: Guard. Armor 2. Can't attack. When this defends, gain 1 Influence.
gateward-colossus.designerNote: 2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. The wall keeps its post; imprisonWatcher dies with prison. Armor 2 + free blocks = the gate that holds.

hierophant.name: Hierophant
hierophant.text: Other friendly units get +1 Power while your Influence is 10 or more.
hierophant.designerNote: Session 006: 2/6 → 3/7. It paid a four-point statline tax for an aura that only works when you are already winning; now it pays two.

inquisitor.name: Inquisitor
inquisitor.text: When this enters play, it captures target enemy unit with 4 or less Power.
inquisitor.designerNote:
Decision 51 text (deterministic pick within the power cap).

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. The senior arrest: bigger writ, bigger body.

mobilize-the-faithful.name: Mobilize the Faithful
mobilize-the-faithful.text: Your units get +1 Power and gain Guard, permanently. Gain 1 Influence.
mobilize-the-faithful.designerNote: Session 006: 4 → 6 mana. A permanent board-wide pump plus mass Guard was priced like a trick; it is a haymaker (red's Warpath gives +1 for one round at 2).

archon-of-order.name: Archon of Order
archon-of-order.text: When this enters play, it captures target enemy unit. Gain 2 Influence.
archon-of-order.designerNote:
Decision 51 text (deterministic pick per zone; zones with no eligible enemies are skipped). The mass-jailer — remember each prisoner costs 1 Influence per round.

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. The 7-cost does a lot (decision 68): a 7/7 that arrests anyone on arrival, publicly.

champion-of-the-faith.name: Champion of the Faith
champion-of-the-faith.designerNote: Session 006: 6/6 → 7/7 (it paid a two-point statline tax for a one-influence trigger — Archon gets a bigger trigger at the same cost with a full body). Text now says "gain" — one shared track, "opponent loses 1" was the same thing said confusingly (decision 15).

command-edict.name: Command Edict
command-edict.text: Your units get Armor 1, permanently. Gain 2 Influence.
command-edict.designerNote: Session 006 redesign: was +2 Armor for one round at 7 — a fog effect priced like a finisher. Now the fortress decree: permanent board-wide Armor 1.

prison-of-light.name: Prison of Light
prison-of-light.text: Choose a zone: exhaust all enemy units there. Gain 2 Influence.
prison-of-light.designerNote:
Session 006, prison ladder: Prison of Light 7 = the zone-wide haymaker. Remember the mortgage: every prisoner costs you 1 Influence per round, so caging an army is a serious bet.

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. Rung 7: the light holds a whole district still for a round — and in v3 a stilled zone cannot block.

radiant-citadel.name: Radiant Citadel
radiant-citadel.text: This can't attack. While this is in play, your opponent's Influence win threshold is increased by 2.
radiant-citadel.designerNote: Decision 49: the card now says exactly what the static does (the old "maximum Influence" text meant nothing on a shared track).

supreme-sentence.name: Supreme Sentence
supreme-sentence.text: Up to two target enemy units anywhere are exhausted and take 2 damage each.
supreme-sentence.designerNote:
Session 006 redesign under decision 50 (no dead thresholds): the old "if your Influence is 15 or more" could never fire — 15 is the win. Now it simply passes two sentences anywhere on the board.

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 3): prison dies (#9), Capture succeeds it. Rung 8: the highest court — two verdicts, anywhere, with teeth.

light-s-vanguard.name: Light's Vanguard
light-s-vanguard.text: Guard. Armor 1. Shielded. When this defends, gain 2 Influence.
light-s-vanguard.designerNote:
Flying is canon (decision 48): may move to any zone, ignoring adjacency.

2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 4): flying is cut — the Vanguard lands and becomes the great shield: 7/8 Guard (free blocks in v3), Armor 1, Shielded, and the court pays 2 when it holds the line. An 8-cost that does a lot (decision 68).

veil-adept.name: Veil Adept
veil-adept.designerNote: Session 006 proposal: The statline pays the ranged tax: shooting without taking counter-damage is worth a stat.

whisper-blade.name: Whisper Blade
whisper-blade.text: When this defeats a unit, gain 1 Influence.
whisper-blade.designerNote: Session 006 proposal: Purple's influence law: the track moves only on kills.

cloak-of-haze.name: Cloak of Haze
cloak-of-haze.designerNote: 2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 2, charter #10: reactive control): the cloak now grants the veil itself — any unit can learn to disappear.

crippling-dart.name: Crippling Dart
crippling-dart.text: Deal 2 damage to target enemy unit. It gets -1 Power permanently.

mist-stalker.name: Mist Stalker
mist-stalker.text: When this defeats a unit, gain 1 Influence.

pacify.name: Pacify
pacify.text: Target enemy unit can't attack this round.

shadowstep.name: Shadowstep
shadowstep.text: Target friendly unit gains Hidden this round. Draw a card.
shadowstep.designerNote: 2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 2, charter #10: reactive control): the escape trick: a round of the veil (ready = safe) plus a card. Purple pays for knowledge either way.

dream-thief.designerNote:
2026-07-11 (v3 churn pass 2, charter #10: reactive control): purple's influence is REACTIVE (decision 63/#10 thread): the thief steals standing, not ground — Sneak gains 2 Influence. Draw stays.

2026-07-11 (#23 consistency sweep): printed text was stale v2.3 ("Flying", a retired keyword) while frontmatter/effects were already v3 (hidden, sneak). Rewritten to match the effects, following the "Hidden. … Sneak — …" convention of its siblings. Flagged in the open-questions ledger for Griff's blessing on the wording.
